title: Bike-share time past the paid window
naturalLanguageRequirements: A rider ends a bike-share trip by docking the bicycle at a station. The source text does not say what the service does when the trip continues after the time the rider paid for.
informalMarkdown:
# Functions

## End a trip

A rider ends a trip by docking the bicycle at a station. What the service does after the paid time is not stated.

# Data Resources

## Trip

The trip records the bicycle, the rider, the start time, and the paid time.

# Constraints

## Docking

A trip ends when the bicycle is docked at a station.

unresolvedSlots.question: What does the service do when a trip continues after the paid time?

alternatives.label: The bicycle locks when the paid time ends, and the rider cannot keep riding.
The rider may keep riding, and each extra minute adds an overtime charge.

unresolvedSlots.clarificationTarget: Whether a trip that runs past the paid time locks the bicycle or keeps going with an overtime charge.
unresolvedSlots.stakeholderAnswer: The rider may keep riding, and each extra minute adds an overtime charge.
